Stock market news | APL Apollo Tubes 15% fall to 52-week low after ₹28,000 deal

APL Apollo Tubes shares plunged 15% to their 52-week low after the company announced a ₹28,000-crore deal to acquire Tata Steel's tubes and colour-coated businesses.
Multiple brokerages including ICICI Securities, Nuvama, Centrum Broking and Axis Capital downgraded the stock, cutting price targets and signalling caution over debt and earnings impact.
